# Onur Ozkir | Software Developer Blog

## Project: End-to-End Observability and Monitoring with Docker and .Net Core
- **Summary**: A complete guide to setting up metrics, logs, and traces using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, and Loki in a .NET Core environment.
- **Key Technologies**: .NET Core, Docker, OpenTelemetry (OTel), Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger, Loki.
- **Architecture**: The API sends OTLP data to OTel Collector, which distributes it to Prometheus (metrics), Jaeger (traces), and Loki (logs).
- **Full Article**: https://onurozkir.com/blogs/observability-and-monitoring/
